verdict.rationale: Stagehand documents an integrations section in which each adapter gives an agent one persistent browser and `run`/`snapshot`/`screenshot` tools. Concrete adapters are documented for CrewAI (v4 server-backed integration and the v3 StagehandTool), Deep Agents (two deployment patterns), and Claude Code over MCP/stdio, with an MCP-integration best-practices page. Missing for 10: any evidence of a Vercel AI SDK adapter, an explicit Claude Agent SDK (rather than Claude Code) or core LangChain adapter, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the adapters work.
